name: chinese_identical_run
checkpoint: 继续数据库迁移工作 已完成部分
why: #127: a Han run is captured as one token, so an identical run in the checkpoint matches. (Word-level matching across differing runs still needs a segmenter — see chinese_segmentation_limit.)

name: ascii_regression
why: Regression guard: pure-ASCII scoring is unchanged by the two-branch tokenizer.

name: chinese_segmentation_limit
checkpoint: 支付模块重构 的后续
why: KNOWN LIMIT: Chinese/Japanese have no word spaces, so a whole run only matches an identical run. '继续重构支付模块' != '支付模块重构'. True word-level parity needs morphological segmentation (jieba/mecab), tracked as a follow-up.

name: korean_short_noun_limit
why: KNOWN LIMIT: the len>3 filter (an English stopword heuristic) drops 2-char Korean nouns 결제/모듈, so continuity built only on short nouns still scores 0. Lowering the CJK length floor is the morphology follow-up; issue #127 deliberately left it.
